Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Raa Quorel: 21-year-old man, 159 cm (short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: heart-shaped face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; broad low bridge, full lips; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a small throat necklace; one mismatched earring. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: immaculate clothes over weathered hands. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
